text.en:
Abolition and Winding-up. - The SZOAD, SPCPD
and the Consultative Assembly are hereby declared to have been
abolished effective August 14, 2001 pursuant to Article XVIII, Section 16
P°MA Outcoing « 09073

The Chairman and Members of the SPCPD and the Consultative
Assembly shall wind up the operations of the SPCPD and the
Consultative Assembly not later than March 31, 2002.

Transfer of Functions and Responsibilities. - The
functions and responsibilities of the SPCPD with regard to the ARM are
hereby transferred to the ARM Regional Government while its functions
and responsibilities with regard to SZOPAD areas outside the ARMM are
hereby transferred to the Southern Philippines Development Authority

Transition Plan.
- The National Economic and
Development Authority (NEDA) shall formulate and submit to the
Executive Secretary for approval a Transition Plan for the orderly transfer
of the functions and responsibilities of the SPCPD to and the absorption
of its qualified personnel in the ARMM Regional Government and the
SPDA. The NEDA shall oversee the implementation of the Transition
Plan which shall be completed within forty-five (45) days from the
issuance of this Executive Order.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect immediately
upon approval.
City of Manila, March 11, 2002.
By the President:
ALBERTOOd. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
